hooks.command:
python3 -c 'import json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys
try:
 d=json.load(sys.stdin); a=(d.get("toolCall") or {}).get("args") or {}; p=a.get("Path") or a.get("TargetFile") or a.get("path") or a.get("file_path") or ""; c=d.get("cwd") or os.getcwd(); t=p if os.path.isabs(p) else os.path.join(c,p); rt=os.path.realpath(t) if p else ""; rc=os.path.realpath(c); ext=os.path.splitext(rt)[1].lower(); f=shutil.which("prettier")
 if p and not d.get("error") and f and os.path.isfile(rt) and os.path.commonpath([rt,rc])==rc and ext in {".js",".jsx",".ts",".tsx",".css",".scss",".json",".md",".yaml",".yml"} and os.path.basename(rt).lower()!="package-lock.json": subprocess.run([f,"--write",rt],cwd=c,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=1.5,check=False)
except Exception:
 pass
print("{}")'
